cases.input: What transaction did Amcor plc disclose in its Form 8-K dated July 1, 2022 (AMCOR_2022_8K_dated-2022-07-01), and which notes (coupon and maturity) were affected? Answer in one or two sentences; no monetary amounts are required.
cases.expected: On June 30, 2022, Amcor Finance (USA), Inc. (the Former Issuer) and Amcor Flexibles North America, Inc. (the Substitute Issuer), both wholly-owned subsidiaries of Amcor plc, entered into supplemental indentures under the 2016 and 2019 Indentures substituting Amcor Flexibles North America for Amcor Finance (USA) as issuer and having the Substitute Issuer assume the Former Issuer's covenants. cases.grounding: On June 30, 2022, Amcor Finance (USA), Inc. (the Former Issuer) and Amcor Flexibles North America, Inc. cases.input: Using PayPal Holdings' consolidated balance sheet as of December 31, 2022 (PAYPAL_2022_10K, in USD millions), does PayPal have positive working capital, defined as total current assets less total current liabilities? cases.expected: Yes: working capital = 57,517 - 45,101 = $12,416 million. Caveat: both sides are dominated by customer balances (funds receivable and customer accounts of $36,357 million within current assets; funds payable and amounts due to customers of $40,107 million within current liabilities), which are pass-through customer funds rather than PayPal's own operating working capital.
